title: Mokambi oyo aponami ya ekólo moko
intro: Na ntango ya mikakatano monene mpe ya kozanga elikya mpo na bato moko, boponami ya Nzambe esalemaki. Moto oyo, oyo na ebandeli bato mingi babosanaki ye, aponama na Allah mpo na kokamba ekolo moko mpo na kobundisa monguna moko ya nsɔmɔ. Lisolo na bango ezali litatoli ya nguya ya bondimi mpe mayele nsima ya mobeko ya bonzambe, kolakisa ete bokambi ya solo ezwami ntango nyonso te na bisika oyo ezelamaki.
clues: Naponama na Allah mpo na kozala mokambi mpo na bato na ngai ntango balukaki mokonzi mpo na kobunda na likambo na Ye.
Bato na ngai batyaki ntembe na ebandeli mpo na koponama na ngai, kokanisaka ete basusu babongi mingi mpo na bozwi to libota na bango.
Elembo ya bokambi na ngai ya malamu ezalaki bozongi ya sanduku moko ya bule, oyo ezalaki na biloko ya kala uta na basakoli ya kala, oyo ememaki kimia.
Nakambaki basoda na ngai na ebale moko, epai namekaki botosi na bango na kopekisa bango komela koleka mbɛki moko ya mai.
Atako motángo moke ya baoyo batikalaki ngwi nsima ya komekama, tokutanaki na mobundi moko ya nguya mpe limpinga na bango.
Na nse ya bokonzi na ngai, elenge moko ya basoda na ngai, oyo azalaki mobundi ya lokumu te, akutanaki na mpiko nyonso mpe alongaki mobundi ya nsɔmɔ ya monguna.

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Bokonzi moko esalemaki na bozwi mpe nguya monene.
Bato bazindaki na mpela moko monene.
Champion ya monguna alongamaki, mpe Allah apesaki elonga.
Kokauka monene etungisaki mokili yango na boumeli ya bambula mingi.
Mokambi yango amelimaki na ekelamu moko ya monene.
outcome.answer: Champion ya monguna alongamaki, mpe Allah apesaki elonga.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
